notes: BCa adjusts for bias and skewness. Ref: Efron & Tibshirani 1993 Ch.14.
Point estimate = statistic on full test set (not bootstrap mean).

patient_sensitivity.note: Percentile bootstrap used instead of BCa because BCa jackknife requires 2974 full dataset evaluations per metric (~26k total), making it computationally infeasible. If boot_mean differs from point_estimate, this is expected for rare-event metrics under patient resampling (prevalence variance).
